subject: Temporary SLA exception request — P1/P2 weekend coverage & escalation ladder
messages:
From: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@greenstone.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: procure@greenstone.com
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary SLA carve-in for Q2 go-live (P1/P2 weekend coverage)

Aisha,

Quick context — Greenstone is scheduled to flip traffic to Redwood for our Q2 analytics pipeline on the weekend of Apr 24–25. That cutover will put us in production across global ETL windows and we expect elevated ticket volume during the first 72 hours.

We need to request a temporary SLA carve-in for P1/P2 response during that weekend: specifically 30-minute P1 acknowledgement and 2-hour P2 acknowledgement for Apr 24 00:00 UTC through Apr 26 23:59 UTC.

Can Redwood commit to the temporary escalation ladder below during that window? If so, we also need the procurement amendment (DocuSign) and a short runbook that maps to Redwood on-call contacts and fallback behavior.

Proposed escalation ladder (Greenstone ask):
- Immediate triage by Redwood 24/7 on-call (ack within 30m for P1)
- If unresolved after 1 hour, escalate to on-call engineer lead + sales (for account context)
- If unresolved after 3 hours, engage engineering manager

We understand carve-ins can have operational cost — please confirm pricing/credits for the temporary SLA and what approvals are needed. Procurement (procure@greenstone.com) is looped for timelines.

Thanks,
Paul
Paul Reynolds
VP, Cloud Operations
Greenstone Analytics

--
Attachment: sample_cutover_plan.xlsx (referenced)
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@greenstone.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA carve-in for Q2 go-live (P1/P2 weekend coverage)

Paul — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. We can support a temporary SLA carve-in for the April 24–26 window with the escalation ladder you suggested, provided we formalize an amendment and agree on the limited scope and credits.

High-level:
- Commitment: 30-minute P1 ack / 2-hour P2 ack for the window Apr 24 00:00 UTC — Apr 26 23:59 UTC.
- Scope: applies to production API endpoints and assigned Greenstone projects only; standard rate limiting and capacity policies still apply.
- Escalation ladder: we'll mirror your levels and add a Redwood on-call manager contact as the final escalation.
- Ops artifacts: we'll provide a short runbook (on-call contacts + handoff checklist) and an escalation-contacts CSV.

Actions I will take today:
1) Loop Ben to confirm commercial approval for a one-time operational credit and amendment.
2) Loop Laura to draft the temporary runbook and confirm on-call coverage plan.
3) Share a DocuSign amendment link and a target for signature before Apr 20.

CC'd Ben and Laura — can you confirm approvals/coverage? Tessa, FYI — please stand by to coordinate CS communication and any training notes for Greenstone support reps.

Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@greenstone.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-11T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA carve-in for Q2 go-live (P1/P2 weekend coverage)

Paul / Aisha — we can operationalize this. Draft plan below; I'll attach the runbook and escalation contacts as promised.

Operational plan (summary):
- Coverage window: Apr 24 00:00 UTC — Apr 26 23:59 UTC (72h).
- On-call staffing: rotate two engineers per 12h shift dedicated to Greenstone incidents (these will be pulled from the EU/US on-call pool to ensure overlap).
- Triage & ack: on-call engineers will ack P1 within 30m, P2 within 2h. For sustained incidents we will escalate per ladder.
- Manager escalation: engineering manager (on-call manager) will be paged after 3 hours for P1s.
- Fallbacks: if GPU inference capacity is constrained, we'll automatically failover to a smaller quantized variant (configured as a canary fallback) to keep latency within SLOs. That fallback behavior will be documented in the runbook.

Required inputs from Greenstone:
- Primary escalation contact and two backups (name + mobile + timezone).
- Any IP allowlists or SSO changes required for weekend support.

Attached: temp_weekend_oncall_runbook.pdf (runbook), escalation-contacts.csv (contact matrix).

I'll be available for a 30-min sync today at 16:00 PT if you want to walk through.

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: temp_weekend_oncall_runbook.pdf; escalation-contacts.csv
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@greenstone.com>, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-11T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA carve-in for Q2 go-live (P1/P2 weekend coverage)

Aisha / Laura — I authorize a temporary SLA carve-in for Greenstone for the Apr 24–26 window under the following conditions:
1) We execute a one-off amendment to the Master Services Agreement (DocuSign) capturing the timebox, scope, and credits.
2) Greenstone procures a temporary operational credit to cover increased on-call staffing (we suggested a 15% credit applied to the monthly usage estimate for the cutover week; final number can be reconciled post-cutover).
3) Legal and Security (security@greenstone.com) sign off on any access exceptions before Apr 20.

DocuSign link (amendment): https://app.docusign.com/agree/abc123-amendment
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/4832

I'll be on standby to approve once procurement confirms the DocuSign execution. Ben

Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Appreciate the help — looking forward to a smooth go-live.
